ValidationRule.description: Enforces replacing dummy last name before converting lead.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "in Sales Qualification"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Converted"), UPPER(TRIM(LastName)) = "Please keep your contact details up to date.")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please edit the contact information and enter a valid First and Last Name!
